main_text.p: genius ad Imperatoris pedes provolutus à militibus interfectus est : Argobastes verò fuga lapsus, proprio gladio se peremit, ubi illud Claudiani de Theodosio distichon arripere liceat,

p.i: O nimium dilecte Deo cui militat æther, Et coniurati veniunt ad classica venti.

main_text.p: Et de his Principicidis illud Athalarici Regis Gothorum, ad Theodosium, cuius cùm frequentiam populi Regiq; mag-nificentiam conspexisset : {d}Paulus Diac.in vi-ta Theod.Sine dubio, inquit, Deus terrenus est Imperator, contra quem quicunque manū leuare nisus fuerit, ipse sui sanguinis reus erit. {e}Ammi-anus lib.5. cap.27[?]. So-zimo li.4.Hunc Athalaricum, licèt infidelem & Christianorum persequutorem acerrimum, quia Re-gem tamen à suis expulsum per hono-rificè excepit Theodosius spatium non exiguum extra Constantinopolim ob-viam ei progressus ; cumque confestim extinctus esset, regia sepultura mortuum terrae mandauit, ipso Imperatore praecedente, & tantam sepulturę magnificentiam adhibente, ut tam superbo funere Barbaris omnibus obstupefactis; Scythiæ quidem domum redirent, nec armis Romanos amplius infestarent, boni-

page.notes: Doubtful: "cap.27" in the left-margin note may read "cap.i27"; checked as printed where legible. The note marks d and e stand in the text before "Sine dubio" and "Hunc". The top line is cut off by the scan edge, so the paragraph begins mid-sentence. The long s is printed as f-like forms, so "esset", "obstupefactis" and "infestarent" are written with plain s. The line-end "boni-" is a printed hyphen that continues on the next page. The ę in "sepulturę" is read from the scan.
